output.english_question: Our product note charges a 2% foreclosure charge to corporate (non-individual) borrowers. Does that conflict with RBI's pre-payment rules for UCBs?
sub_queries: RBI UCB prepayment rules foreclosure charge 2%
RBI guidelines prepayment charges UCB penal charges foreclosure
premises: RBI has specific pre-payment / foreclosure (pre-closure) charge rules that apply to UCBs (Urban Co-operative Banks).
The product note applies a foreclosure/pre-closure charge rate of 2% to corporate (non-individual) borrowers.
